facts.fact: UNDP Togo says a digital assistant at the Direction nationale du contrôle de la commande publique helps staff search and analyse public procurement information, cutting a task from days to under a day.
UNDP Togo says a solution is being developed for the Ministry of Security to automate compliance checks of recruitment-competition applications.
